gaps.description: No first-party email send tool registered. §3 Multi-Channel Distribution currently covers Slack + Confluence (via twg) but not direct email blast to executives or external stakeholders.

No calendar/availability tool registered for the role. Status review meetings, blocker triage syncs, and metrics retros have no native scheduling coverage. Federated 'meetings' surface in twg is read-only.

Bitbucket access via twg covers PR/commit/branch metadata but there is no dedicated tool for pipeline status, build health, deployment frequency, or DORA metrics — needed for §2 Metrics & Trend Analysis on engineering delivery KPIs.

No tool aggregates cross-program KPIs (cycle time, throughput, blocker-burn-down, on-time delivery %) into a structured analytics surface. §2 Metrics & Trend Analysis must currently be hand-rolled from twg query outputs.

No templating tool for rendering status reports, exec summaries, or RAG dashboards. §2 Status Reporting requires composing Markdown/ADF inline before publishing via twg confluence or slack_send_message.
twg returns issue links as data; there is no tool to render a visual dependency graph or critical-path view. §2 Dependency Graph Maintenance is currently text/JSON only.
No survey/poll tool — feedback loops on program health, retro signals, stakeholder NPS (continuous_improvement principle) are not directly supported.
twg can read federated docs (Google Docs, SharePoint) but cannot create/edit them. Executive-facing artifacts that live outside Confluence have no creation path.
